naming-onchainvalidatorsapplicationak.text: The application validator takes an immutable request-validator hash derived for the same state policy and cage token. It is never selected by the redeemer. Spending uses Maintain, Retire or Recover; minting uses Approve to certify one bound edge.

Booking approvals require the controller's signature and bind the well-formed record destination. Absent insertion is open; absent deletion requires the recorded refund key; active deletion is never certified.

Retirement requires the committed recovery key or a distinct-member quorum. The same transaction mints the bound approval, moves the active token to custody, and produces the completion request at the applied ordinary request validator with the same registry token. The leaf remains active. Wrong identity, token, reveal or approval refuses beside a valid positive control.
